title: Improving the Training of Rectified Flows
tldr_zh: 一轮 reflow 即近乎直；U 形时间步 + LPIPS-Huber 前度量，CIFAR-10 一步 FID 12.21→3.07，ImageNet-64 一步 4.31 超 CD/PD
tldr_en: One reflow round suffices under realistic settings; U-shaped timestep distribution and LPIPS-Huber premetric cut CIFAR-10 one-step FID 12.21->3.07 and beat CD/PD on ImageNet-64.
key_numbers: ImageNet 64x64 one-step FID 4.31, two-step 3.64 vs iCT 4.02/3.20, CD 6.20/4.70, PD 15.39/8.95 (Table 4)
Ablation CIFAR-10 1-NFE: 12.21 (A) -> 7.14 (EDM init + batch 512) -> 5.17 (U-shaped p_t) -> 3.38 (LPIPS-Huber-1/t) -> 3.07 (real data) (Table 1)
Reflow total forward passes 1828.6M vs CD x3.1, CT x1.5 on ImageNet-64 (Table 6)
Inversion: 2-RF++ with 2 NFE lower reconstruction MSE than EDM with 16 NFE (Fig. 5a)
